in_sanskrit.name: साकार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sa (स) meaning 'complete, whole, perfect', and kar (कर) meaning 'doer, maker'. Together, Saakar (साकार) means 'complete doer', 'whole maker', 'perfect creator', or 'full being'.

in_hindi.name: साकार
in_hindi.long_meaning: Saakar (साकार) in Hindi can mean 'complete', 'whole', 'full', or 'perfect'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'sa' meaning 'complete, whole, perfect' and the suffix 'kar' meaning 'doer, maker'.

in_tamil.name: சாகார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Saakar (சாகார்) in Tamil can mean 'ambal', 'ambalam', 'ampalam', or 'full'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'sa' meaning 'complete, whole, perfect' and the suffix 'kar' meaning 'doer, maker'.

in_telugu.name: శాకార
in_telugu.long_meaning: Saakar (శాకార) in Telugu can mean 'purnam', 'purname', or 'purnaya'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'sa' meaning 'complete, whole, perfect' and the suffix 'kar' meaning 'doer, maker'.

in_marathi.name: Saakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saakar means mass or body. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'saakar' which means 'real' or 'existing'.
